title: Export button does nothing
description: Since this morning the export button on the reports page does nothing when I click it. Our monthly report is due at 3pm today.

title: Nobody can log in
description: None of our staff can log in since about 9am. Everyone gets sent back to the sign-in page. We're completely blocked.

title: Typo on the dashboard
description: The dashboard header says 'Recieved' instead of 'Received'.

title: 500 error when saving a profile
description: When I edit a user's phone number and press save I get a 500 error. If I refresh and try again it sometimes works.

title: App crashes on Android
description: The mobile app crashes every time I open the notifications screen on my Samsung phone.

title: Invoices showing the wrong total
description: The invoice PDFs we sent to three customers show the wrong total, the VAT is added twice. We need this fixed ASAP.

title: Button colour looks off
description: The save button on the settings page is a slightly different blue from the rest of the app.

title: Search is very slow
description: Searching for a client takes 20-30 seconds. It used to be instant. We can still use it but it's painful.

title: Export to Excel
description: It would be great if we could export reports to Excel as well as PDF.

title: Dark mode please
description: A lot of our team work late. Could you add a dark mode to the web app?

title: Bulk edit users
description: We'd love the ability to change the role of many users at once instead of one by one.

title: Slack notifications
description: Can we have notifications sent to our Slack channel when a new booking comes in?

title: Recurring appointments
description: Please add an option to make an appointment repeat every week.

title: How do I add a new user?
description: I'm new to the account. How do I add a colleague so they can log in?

title: Where are old invoices?
description: Where can I find invoices from last year?

title: Is there an API?
description: Is it possible to connect our CRM to your system? Do you have an API we can use?

title: The app feels weird
description: Something about the app feels off lately, not sure what.

title: Charged twice and want a refund
description: We were charged twice this month. This is unacceptable, we want a refund or we'll cancel.

title: Few things
description: The calendar is slow, also can you add a print button, and how do I change my password?

title: Password reset email never arrives
description: I asked for a password reset three times and never got the email. I can't get into my account.
